text:
alex: Heads up — OrionCloud just flagged a lane change for container C-987 affecting our reserved shipment. Manifests show 3 of 10 rack units moved to a delayed feeder, ETA +5 days. Need quick decision on reallocation.

logistics-bot: [automated] Container C-987 lane change detected. Original ETA 1876620000 -> new ETA 1877060000 (+5d). Manifest: https://orion.example/manifest/C-987 :ship:

maria: how many dedicated racks are in that container vs marketplace/backfill?

orion-cloud-rep: sorry for the disruption — confirmed: container holds 10 racks, 7 are for Marketplace/pool, 3 are Reserved (customer-dedicated). Port congestion + terminal shift caused re-lane. We can priority-rebook the 3 onto next day feeder but it costs a re-route fee and may bump one other shipment.

samir: which customers will be impacted if those 3 reserved racks slip 5 days? we have two Dedicated commitments starting next Tue (Acala & Nimbus). If we miss, SLA credit + onboarding risk.

helen: short options: (A) accept rebooking (pay fee) and get racks +1 day via priority; (B) reallocate those two Acala racks from regional pool (APAC -> US swap) and use marketplace burst for Nimbus for 5 days; (C) partial ship 2 now and leave 1 delayed. Need cost deltas for B/C.

jonas: I can do a quick allocation map. Proposal: move 2 racks from reserved pool in us-west to Acala, swap 2 marketplace racks backfill into us-west for Nimbus, and accept 1 delayed rack. Patch (pseudo):
reserved_alloc = { Acala: racks 4 -> 6, Nimbus: racks 3 -> 3, marketplace_burst: 2 }
This keeps both customers online; marketplace burst cost approx +$2k/day (estimate).

alex: Jonas, can you confirm inventory counts and lead time for swapping? If marketplace burst is acceptable, I'd prefer to avoid re-route fees. Also @orion-cloud-rep can you confirm the exact re-route fee vs us doing regional swap ourselves?

orion-cloud-rep: Re-route fee for priority rebook is $7,500 for the container. If you handle regional swap internally, we can waive the fee but there is manual handling lead time ~8 hours to reassign manifests. We'll provide revised bill-of-lading and manifest within 3 business hours if you choose swap.

maria: quick risk note — swapping racks across regions will increase our internal cross-dock ops and may add 4-6 hours for setup. We need SRE to confirm we can bring up capacity in target region within that window.

samir: ops check — tagging SRE now. If we go marketplace burst, include cost code and notify finance. If we take re-route, request credit negotiation for the $7.5k (partial offset).

alex: decision: proceed with internal regional swap + marketplace burst for Nimbus as fallback. Jonas/maria, please execute reallocation and confirm inventories. @orion-cloud-rep stand by for manifest changes; we'll request your revised BOL after we confirm the swap.

logistics-bot: Task created: #SHIP-4531 reassign-manifest (assigned: jonas). ETA for manifest update from Orion if requested: 3h.

orion-cloud-rep: Understood. Will hold the container at terminal for 6h awaiting your manifest swap request. If no request by 1876546800 we'll auto-priority-rebook (incurs fee). Sending current manifest to alex@m.redwood now.

alex: thanks — Jonas/Maria, loop SRE & finance in the update thread and paste final allocation here when done. :eyes:
